name: runtime-contracts
description: Check preconditions, postconditions and assertions of correct programs with the C++26 contract semantics (ignore, observe, enforce, quick_enforce) and a replaceable violation handler, written inside a function body or laid over an existing callable from outside, with the semantic selectable from the build; the overlay's conditions also serve as the callable's test oracle, shown by the contracts demo. Not input validation.
rationale: Invariant violations (bugs) are a separate responsibility from rejecting hostile input; keeping them apart prevents validation from being compiled out with the ignore semantic.
